column_description: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each sensor data record.
A REAL value indicating the recommended or target storage temperature in Celsius.
A DECIMAL(4,1) specifying allowable temperature deviation (±°C).
A REAL number for the current actual temperature reading in Celsius.
A SMALLINT counting how many times the temperature has deviated beyond the allowed tolerance.
A DECIMAL(5,2) representing the maximum temperature recorded (in °C).
A DECIMAL(5,2) representing the minimum temperature recorded (in °C).
A REAL value indicating a temperature stability index or coefficient.
A DECIMAL(4,1) showing the percentage of humidity inside or around the container.
A REAL number representing the recorded pressure in kilopascals (kPa).
An enum (SensorStatus_enum) describing the shock sensor status (e.g., Normal, Malfunction, Triggered).
An enum (SensorStatus_enum) describing the tilt sensor status (e.g., Normal, Triggered, Malfunction).
An enum (SensorStatus_enum) describing the impact sensor status (e.g., Normal, Triggered, Malfunction).
A DECIMAL(6,2) measuring vibration level in mm/s (millimeters per second).
An INTEGER for the current or last known light level in lux.
A REAL value capturing acceleration data (e.g., in m/s²) from the sensor.
A SMALLINT counting non-critical handling events (minor jolts, slight tilts).
A SMALLINT recording critical events (major shocks, severe impacts).
A SMALLINT tally of all sensor alerts triggered within a specific timeframe.
A TIMESTAMP marking the most recent alert event time.
A VARCHAR(50) describing the kind or category of the last triggered alert.
A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing Container(ContainRegistry). Associates sensor data with a specific container.
A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing TransportInfo(VehicleReg). Links sensor data to a particular vehicle.
